Display everything in Matigsalug (vs. use English for settings, etc.).
Papitew langun te Minatigsalug (vs. gamit te English for settings, etc.).
This simple app displays the two Matigsalug dictionaries. First you select the book that you want to go to, then the chapter number. (Chapter zero, if it\'s shown, is the introduction to the book.)

Seini ne simple app displays ka daruwa ne Matigsalug ne diksiyunari Bibliya section-by-section. An-anayan alam ka te libru that you want to go to, then the kapitulu number. (Kapitulu zero, if it\'s shown, is the introduction to the libru.)
The settings menu allows you to choose whether or not verse numbers, and footnote and cross-reference markers are displayed.
The settings menu allows you to choose whether or not birsikulu numbers, wey footnote wey cross-reference markers are displayed.
When a Bible section is displayed, you can swipe left or right to go the previous or next section. If you double-tap, you go into the single verse view.
When a section te Bibliya is displayed, you can swipe left or right to go the previous or next section. If you double-tap, you go into the single birsikulu view.

The single verse view displays individual verses, along with any footnotes or cross-references. Swiping left or right now goes to the previous or next verse. Press Back (or double-tap again) to go back to section view.

The single birsikulu view displays individual birsikulu, along with any footnotes or cross-references. Swiping left or right now goes to the previous or next birsikulu. Press Back (or double-tap again) to go back to section view.
